name: STS35 high-accuracy temperature sensor
description: Sensirion high-accuracy digital temperature sensor (-40 to 125 °C, ±0.1 °C typical from 20 to 60 °C) with an I2C interface and CRC-checked readings. Sold as: DFRobot Fermion: STS35 High Accuracy Digital Temperature Sensor (SEN0434), 6-pin header VCC, GND, SCL, SDA, RST, ADDR, 3.3–5.5 V, I2C address 0x4B (0x4A with ADDR pulled low).
eli5: A very precise thermometer that tells your board the temperature to a tenth of a degree.

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock (10 kΩ pull-up on the board)

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data (10 kΩ pull-up on the board)

pins.name: RST
pins.description: Active-low reset (pull low ≥ 1 µs to reset); leave unconnected for normal use

pins.name: ADDR
pins.description: Address select: pulled high on the board = 0x4B; tie to GND for 0x4A

supplierQuery: DFRobot SEN0434 STS35 high accuracy temperature sensor
buildNotes: Single-shot command 0x24 0x00, then wait at least 15.5 ms before reading 3 bytes: temperature MSB, LSB, CRC.
Check the CRC (poly 0x31, init 0xFF). A mismatch almost always means a loose SDA/SCL wire.
The DFRobot board pulls ADDR high, so its address is 0x4B (not the chip's 0x4A default). Tie ADDR to GND for 0x4A, e.g. for a second sensor.
Keep the sensor away from the regulator and the microcontroller, which warm the air around them; the board's cut-out slots help isolate it.

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from sts35 import STS35

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
sensor = STS35(i2c)
while True:
    print('T=%.2fC' % sensor.temperature())
    time.sleep(1)
